label: Bible Study
prompt: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many _____ have I made thee.
verse: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee.
note: A new name for a man still waiting on a son — Abram becomes Abraham, and the name itself is a promise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these _____; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
verse: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
note: In the valley of dry bones, God promises breath — and the bones stand up as an exceeding great army.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Saul cast the _____; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
verse: And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.
note: Saul's jealousy took aim: he cast the javelin, and David sidestepped — twice.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I _____ him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verse: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, Micaiah the son of Imlah, by whom we may enquire of the LORD: but I hate him; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me, but evil. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
note: Ahab's problem with Micaiah: the prophet only ever told him the truth.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was _____.
verse: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
note: Aaron ran with his censer and 'stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.' Intercession on the run.
